en.name: Shell Game
effects:
{Paid Effect}Pay 3¢: roll-
3: Gain 1¢.
4: Loot 1.
5: Gain 5¢.
6: Gain +1 treasure. Put this into discard.

en.name: Experimental Treatment
effects:
{Paid Effect}Destroy this: roll-
1: You die.
2: Loot 3.
3: Gain 9¢.
4: Gain +1 treasure.
5: Gain +2 treasure.
6: This becomes a soul. Gain it.

en.name: Backstabber
effects: You may attack players who control more souls than you. They have 3+{DC} for the attack.
Each time you kill a player, loot 1.

en.name: The Beast!
effects:
When this is flipped to this side or attacked, each player rolls-
Each player who rolls the lowest or tied for the lowest dies.

en.name: Abyss
effects: {Tap Effect}Destroy an item you control. If you do, put a counter on this.
You have +1{ATK} for every 2 counters on this.

footnotes.title: -Eternal-
footnotes.text: This can't be destroyed or put into discard.

en.name: The Revenant
effects: When this reaches 0{HP}, the player attacking this gains its reward, then you flip it. That player may attack an additional time this turn.

footnotes.title: -Eternal-
footnotes.text: This can't be destroyed or put into discard.
